# Start / stop a service (`service.control`)

**Kind:** action · **Category:** Advanced · **Runs as:** SYSTEM (machine automations only) · **Revertible:** yes

Starts or stops a Windows service.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | text | yes |  | Service name (as in services.msc > Properties > Service name). Supports [placeholders](../placeholders.md). |
| `state` | one of: `running`, `stopped` | yes |  | running or stopped. |
| `timeout` | duration (`30s`, `5m`, `1h30m`) | no | `30s` | How long to wait for the service to reach the state. |
| `continue_on_error` | true / false | no | `false` | Keep running the next actions even if this one fails. |

## Example

```yaml
actions:
  - type: service.control
    name: wuauserv
    state: stopped
```

## In profiles

When this action is part of a [profile](../../guide/profiles.md), the current value is saved before it runs and
restored when the profile is reverted. Two actions of this type change the same setting when their `name` is the same.

## Notes

Machine automations only (requires administrator rights).
